text_block_list.text:
While out with Marvelous Sunday, we 
decided to go on a short hike, but—

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Caught the monkey☆★☆

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Cheval-chan! I got your stolen luggage 
back!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Th-Thank you... I-I'm so sorry you had to 
carry my luggage of all things...
choice_data_list: No, no, I'm just glad you got it back.

text_block_list.text:
I bumped into them on the way and we ended 
up hanging out together. Never did I 
expect we'd run into an actual monkey, 
though—

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: By the way... where on earth are we?

text_block_list.name: Everyone
text_block_list.text: D-Does this mean... we're stranded~~?!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Mmmh... it's no good. Looks like there's 
no reception around here.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
"Wh-What should I do... ?! I have to... I 
have to call for help...!"

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
It's okay, don't worry☆★ The path is this 
way☆★

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Follow me, everyone☆★ Let the fun 
adventure begin~☆

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Um, Marvelous-san, doesn't it feel like 
we've kinda been climbing higher and 
higher for a while now?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
"Indeed... I've heard that when you're 
lost, you shouldn't move around too much, 
but..."

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
It's okay☆★ We're definitely getting 
closer to the bottom☆★

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Ah, everyone, look, look! There's 
something in those bushes! I sense 
something Marvelous☆★☆

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Huh? Ah, you're right. Is that... a well?

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Ooh☆ That means humans have maintained 
this area! There's gotta be a path 
nearby～★

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, you can tell even that much? That's 
so interesting...!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! That's the real thrill of an 
adventure☆ Let's keep on going in a 
Marvelous mood~★☆★

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Haa, haa... I've walked quite a bit... 
Where even am I right now...

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Great work today, everyone☆ Let's make a 
little detour on the way back★

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Whoa... What a big river...!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Now, get your plastic bottles and 
handkerchiefs ready☆ Time to gather gravel 
and pebblesっ★☆

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Let's filter some water here and hydrate! 
☆★

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Huh, water from this river...!? That's 
amazing, I can't wait...!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Phaaah! Water tastes so good~!!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
"Still, you're so knowledgeable, 
Marvelous-san. To think you even know how 
to purify water!"

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe~ I explore historic ruins all the 
time! Getting stranded is totally routine☆ 
So survival is a piece of cake for me★

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
I-Incredible... That's why she was walking 
with such certainty...

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
"Let's head out after a quick break!☆ 
Judging by where the sun is~, we've still 
got about an hour before dusk, right?"

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
If we walk in that direction for another 
20 minutes, we should reach the foot of 
the mountain☆★ Just a little further☆★☆

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
I promise I'll bring everyone safely back 
to the academy, so don't you worry! ☆

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Soooo coooool~~~!! You look just like the 
leader of an expedition team...!

text_block_list.name: The Three
text_block_list.text:
—I'll follow you to the ends of the earth, 
Captain!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
W-We actually made it back...! For 
real...!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Great work, everyone☆★ That was a truly 
marvelous adventure!
choice_data_list: It was tough, but it was fun.
It was tough, but it was fun, wasn't it?

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Great work, everyone☆★ That was a truly 
marvelous adventure!
choice_data_list: It was tough, but it was fun.
It was tough, but it was fun, wasn't it?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Yes, totally! I completely forgot that we 
were stranded halfway through♪

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Fufu~ Everyone having fun makes me happy 
too! Marvelouuus☆★☆★

Marvelous Sunday managed to turn trouble 
into a wonderful experience. It was a 
moment that showed just how dependable she 
truly is.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Finding old wells, purifying river 
water... T-This kind of survival... might 
be pretty hard to come by...

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
A pinch is an opportunity, and that's 
Marvelous☆★☆ Survival is so much fun 
precisely because it's unpredictable★

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I see...! Marvelous-san, if there's 
another chance, I'd love for you to teach 
me more survival tips!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Of cooourse☆★☆★ Let's all do the survival 
experience together again♪
